newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Shell's Manila unit cuts lpg, diesel prices.
newsitem.headline: Shell's Manila unit cuts lpg, diesel prices.

text.p: Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp said on Thursday it will lower prices of liquefied petroleum gasoline (lpg) and diesel but will keep prices of other petroleum products unchanged.
The company said diesel price will be cut by five centavos per litre to 7.65 pesos from 7.70 pesos while lpg will be reduced by two pesos per 11-kilogram cylinder to 155 pesos from 157 pesos.

Prices of other oil-based products will remain the same: unleaded gasoline at 10.99 pesos a litre, premium gasoline at 11.40 pesos, regular gasoline at 10.34 pesos, fuel oil at 3.80 pesos, and kerosene at 6.43 pesos.
Company officials said increasing competition from new entrants in the lpg and diesel business had prompted the reduction in prices.
The company said the new prices will take effect at 0001 hours on Saturday (1601 GMT Friday).
Pilipinas Shell, a member of the Royal Dutch/Shell group of companies, was the first of three local oil refiners to announce price adjustments for the month of June.
